hint.text: The Board welcomes gifts. The Board welcomes the gifts you will inevitably give.

offer.text: A Warden gala needs a sponsor. Installments are 4 refined per inmate; 20 refined is five inmates' worth of paperwork.

sponsor.label: Sponsor the gala (20 refined)
sponsor.text: Your rank has improved. Your standing has not.
sponsor.hint: Costs 20 refined (5 installments of 4). Petition fee +10% for good.

decline.label: Decline politely
decline.text: The Board notes the absence of a gift. The Board notes everything.

bribe.label: Bribe the Informant (10 refined)
bribe.text: The Informant sells audit dates. He remains the Warden's. Both of you are paid.
bribe.hint: Costs 10 refined (2.5 installments). Audit parts -20% for 6 days.
